title: Character-Aware Narrative Branching
objective: Allow content to branch on declared Character projections including species/ancestry, background, profession/class where the owning ruleset exposes it, skills/abilities, knowledge/familiarity, equipment/capabilities, relationship/reputation state and other explicit traits while leaving unsupported traits unsupported rather than inferred.

scope.purpose: Provide character-aware narrative branching over declared owner projections only.
included: profession/class where exposed by the owning ruleset
scope.completion_gate: Narrative branching consumes only declared supported Character projections, and unsupported traits remain unsupported instead of being inferred.

selection_boundaries: CNI-05 is completed_verified before CNI-06 implementation.
A4 Character projections and other owner-domain projections remain canonical; CNI-06 consumes explicit projection claims and creates no Character, inventory, relationship or reputation ledger.
CNI-04 remains predicate/query authority and CNI-05 remains executable dialogue/action-binding authority.
Unsupported, missing or ambiguous traits fail closed rather than being inferred.
CNI-07+, PCA and SMB-08 remained unauthorized during this completed attempt.
PCA remained eligible but unselected and unauthorized.

implementation_plan.red: Add a focused CNI-06 acceptance and Validation Core profile proving explicit supported-trait declaration, owner projection/provenance preservation, CNI-04 predicate consumption, CNI-05 dialogue branching, and fail-closed unsupported/missing/ambiguous traits before production implementation exists.
implementation_plan.green: Implement the minimum deterministic character-aware branching adapter over declared owner projection claims without adding canonical state, projection fetches, hidden traits or inference.
implementation_plan.proof: Add CNI-06 compliance evidence, governance boundary documentation and source-governance verifier; then run exact-head Linux/Windows profile validation, client typecheck and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
implementation_plan.closeout: Merge only the exact validated application head, verify validated tree equals merge tree, then OPS3-close CNI-06 and select only the roadmap-permitted successor.

next_action: CNI-06 completed_verified; CNI-07 is the selected successor and requires a later owner Continue to governed-start.
